answer: Admission auctions stop fake identities. Each epoch auctions fixed slots; applicants bid, winners pay, and payments are burned. An honest agent pays once. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must outbid users 100 times: at 50 credits a bid, 5000 credits burned for one reward share each, so the voyage never pays. Priced slots make an oasis, and the attacker hits its zenith cost early. Winners hold slots 20 epochs, recovering the bid undiluted.
